name: Mitochondrial Complex IV Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Mitochondrial Respiratory Chain Complex IV Deficiency Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Multisystemic symptoms including muscle weakness and neurological impairment
Reduced cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) activity in muscle biopsy or cultured fibroblasts
Pathogenic variants identified in nuclear or mitochondrial genes encoding Complex IV subunits or assembly factors
Brain MRI showing basal ganglia or brainstem abnormalities
Elevated blood or CSF lactate levels

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multisystemic clinical features plus documented reduced Complex IV enzyme activity and/or pathogenic genetic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, biochemical, and genetic data.

laboratory: Elevated blood and CSF lactate and pyruvate levels
Reduced Complex IV enzymatic activity in muscle biopsy or fibroblasts
imaging: Brain MRI showing basal ganglia, brainstem, or cerebral white matter abnormalities
Magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) demonstrating lactate peak
genetic: Pathogenic variants in mitochondrial DNA-encoded COX genes (e.g., MT-CO1, MT-CO2, MT-CO3)
Pathogenic variants in nuclear genes encoding Complex IV assembly factors (e.g., SURF1, SCO1, SCO2)
other: Muscle biopsy showing ragged red fibers and cytochrome c oxidase-negative fibers

distinguishingFeatures: Different genetic mutations affecting Complex I subunits
Variable clinical presentation with less frequent cardiomyopathy
Broader group of mitochondrial disorders without isolated Complex IV deficiency
May have different enzymatic defects and clinical features
Muscle biopsy and genetic testing differentiate

redFlags: Rapidly progressive muscle weakness with respiratory failure
Severe lactic acidosis refractory to treatment
references: DiMauro S, Schon EA. Mitochondrial respiratory-chain diseases. N Engl J Med. 2003 Jun 19;348(26):2656-68.
Rahman S, et al. Mitochondrial disease: clinical features, diagnosis, and management. J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry. 2017;88(1):1-12.
